title: Pop-Bang
description: Plays an overrun effect through the car's speakers the moment you lift off after a rev - when a real exhaust crackles. Watches engine speed and fires on the lift, picking a harder effect the higher the revs were and the faster they fall. Ten effects, from a couple of ticks to a bang with a tail. Nothing is written to the engine: no valve is moved, no coding changes, the exhaust does exactly what it always does. Needs the Sound tool (the Store installs it with the app).

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.CDS._notes: engine speed: arms the detector past armRpm and, without a pedal signal, finds the lift from how fast it falls

de.bmw.infotainment.vehicle.Vehicle2._notes: road speed, for the optional parked-only gate

de.bmw.powertrain.AcceleratorPedal._optional: the lift is found from falling engine speed instead of the pedal

org.genivi.am.commandinterface.CommandCo._notes: AudioManager: connect source 287 (SmartX CarLifeMedia, free outside China) to sink 1024 (main speaker) around each effect

org.genivi.am.routinginterface.RoutingCo._notes: 287 is A_UNAVAILABLE by default and a connect to it hangs in CS_CONNECTING; it has to be marked available here first
